about: Traffic the harness causes on its own clock, whichever suite is running. The checker leaves it out of the suites' replies and traffic corpus. Nothing else may be left out by hand: add an entry here only with the source that sends it.

mysql_connections.source: regression-test/plugins/plugin_query_timeout_debugger.groovy: every 5 minutes, a new connection looks up the backends

be_http.source: the reference image's health check (/opt/doris-ci/health_check.sh), every few seconds
